title: Inverse image, tensor product and extension by zero preserve $D^b_c(-,\mathcal O_E)$
statement:
Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite and all schemes Noetherian.

1. For $f\colon X\to Y$ and $K\in\Dbc(Y,\cO_E)$, $f^*K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$.
2. For $K,M\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$, $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\cO_{E,X}}M\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$ (no completion is
   needed).
3. For a locally closed immersion $a=i\circ u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S\hookrightarrow X$
   and $L\in\Dbc(S,\cO_E)$, $a_!L=i_*u_!L\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$.
4. For $a$ as in (3), $L\in D(S_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$ and $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$,
   $(a_!L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}M\simeq a_!(L\otimes^{\mathbf L}a^*M)$.

proof.text: Use the adic predicate comparison on X and Y. Underived module pullback preserves stratified local finite presentation. Exact pullback commutes with homology and preserves the standard t-structure bounds; these facts prove clause (1). No field base or finite-type hypothesis is introduced.

For two sheaves in degree zero, form their common locally closed stratification by actual fibre-product intersections. On each stratum transport the local finite presentations through the Cartesian coefficient isomorphism. Strong monoidal derived restriction reduces the tensor to the two local sheaves. The local tensor theorem gives finite-presentation cohomology and lower bound -1. The general derived tensor upper bound is 0. Restrictions to the jointly surjective family of strata detect zero abelian sheaves, hence zero internal modules, so the bounds hold globally. The common stratification proves constructibility of each cohomology. This is a private proved helper, adapting the existing boundedConstructible_tensor_single argument without its unused field-base hypotheses.

The integral stratified finite-presentation bounded category is triangulated. Apply the bounded Postnikov devissage first with the second sheaf fixed, and then with the first bounded complex fixed. Tensor is exact in each variable. The degree-zero case is step 2. Transport the resulting membership through the adic predicate comparison to prove clause (2), with the ambient uncompleted tensor.

For the open factor use its canonical closed complement; for the closed factor use its canonical open complement. ScalarModelImmersionExtension gives constructibility preservation and exact closed direct image. Exact open extension and closed direct image commute with homology and preserve bounds. The right-derived-to-termwise comparison gives clause (3) in its stated right-derived presentation. The existing well-definedness theorem supplies isomorphism invariance of finite constant scalar-model constructibility.

All complementary opens are quasi-compact on Noetherian schemes. The support adjunction makes the closed direct image exact. Apply the existing unbounded closed support projection to u_!L and M. Transport supportPullback to upperStar. Apply the inverse open support projection inside the closure. The derived image of upperStarComp identifies successive inverse images with the composite inverse image. Finally transport both occurrences of the termwise closed image through its canonical right-derived comparison. Compose these isomorphisms to obtain clause (4) for arbitrary unbounded inputs. The private proved immersion_projection helper keeps the coefficient abstract during these transports.
